title: Open & Release: A 9D Breathwork + Heart-Opening Yoga Journey in Tribeca
description: A 3-hr immersive NYC wellness experience combining heart-opening yoga, 9D Breathwork, nervous system regulation, and intentional connection.
long_description:
A 3-hr immersive NYC wellness experience combining heart-opening yoga, 9D Breathwork, nervous system regulation, and intentional connection.

About this Event

Move. Breathe. Regulate.
New York asks a lot of our nervous systems.
We move quickly. We stay connected. We push through. And sometimes we need an intentional space to slow everything down.
Open & Release is a three-hour immersive mind-body experience in Lower Manhattan created to give you that space.
We’ll move.
We’ll breathe.
We’ll reconnect with the body.
And then we’ll give ourselves time to simply be.
Your morning begins with gentle, heart-opening yoga before transitioning into an immersive 9D Breathwork journey. Afterward, we’ll move gently back into the body and close together with a nervous-system regulation circle, grounding tea, light bites, and community.
No prior yoga or breathwork experience is necessary.
Come exactly as you are.

WHAT YOU’LL EXPERIENCE

HEART-OPENING GENTLE YOGACertified Yoga Instructor Ethel Zhang will begin the experience with gentle, intentional movement designed to create space through the body, open the heart, and prepare you for the breathwork journey.
This is not about perfect poses or performance.
It’s about reconnecting with your body.

IMMERSIVE 9D BREATHWORKThen we go inward.
Certified 9D Breathwork Facilitator Lily Acevedo will guide you through a multi-sensory breathwork journey combining conscious connected breathing with multidimensional audio, music, guided coaching, affirmations, and somatic cues.
Unlike simply listening to a meditation or attending a sound bath, you are actively participating through your breath.
The experience creates an opportunity to slow down, turn inward, explore held tension and emotion, and reconnect with yourself on a deeper level.
There is no “right” experience to have.
Some people notice physical sensations. Some experience emotion or insight. Others experience profound stillness.
Your experience is your own.

INTEGRATION + NERVOUS SY
